description: Stops a build that's still building, wherever it runs (GitHub, Ploa's machines, the person's Google Cloud, Xcode Cloud, or a computer with the CLI), as the Stop button on the dashboard does. Like the dashboard, it takes two steps: called without confirm, it changes nothing and says what the build is and what stopping does where it runs; show that to the person, and only once they say yes, call again with confirm: true. Without releaseId it picks the app's newest build that's still building. A stopped build can't be picked up again; the dashboard and ploa_runs show it as stopped by you. A web version still going up to its testing address stops the same way: pass webVersion (its build number) and site. Needs a token allowed to make drafts.

confirm.description: true only after the person said yes to stopping it.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

releaseId.description: The build's release ID (ploa_runs lists them). Defaults to the app's newest build still building.

site.description: With webVersion: the site's address, when the workspace has more than one.

webVersion.description: A web version to stop instead: its build number (ploa_web_status lists them).

name: ploa_release_stop
title: Stop a build
